professionalSummary.text: Builds and maintains React components in the company design system with TypeScript.
professionalSummary.witness: Frontend engineer at Quillstack (project-management software), May 2021 to present, building React and TypeScript components for the company's design system, including the date picker, data table and toast notifications.

experienceHighlights.text: Audits interfaces against WCAG 2.2 AA and fixes accessibility defects.
experienceHighlights.witness: Audited the checkout and account-settings flows against WCAG 2.2 AA and fixed 37 defects, including focus order, colour contrast and form error announcements.

experienceHighlights.text: Writes visual regression and unit tests for components.
experienceHighlights.witness: Added visual regression tests for 60 design-system components and unit tests for keyboard interaction on every interactive component.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Writes component documentation on the design-system site.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Wrote usage guidance, do-and-don't examples and prop tables for the design-system documentation site, and added a keyboard-interaction section to each interactive component's page.

skills.text: Mentors junior engineers through structured code review and pairing.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in building React components with TypeScript, auditing interfaces against WCAG 2.2 AA, writing visual regression and unit tests, and writing documentation for the design-system site. They do not establish the candidate's mentorship of junior engineers through structured code review and pairing.

decisionBoundary.statement: The materials provide evidence for some requirements but not all, and further human review is required to assess the candidate's suitability for the role.

evidence.text: Frontend engineer at Quillstack (project-management software), May 2021 to present, building React and TypeScript components for the company's design system, including the date picker, data table and toast notifications.
